provenance: All fixtures are self-written acceptance contracts; none are extracted reference or upstream source.
review: Positive fixtures are bounded pure generated programs with only fingerprinted self-written source dependencies, no foreign libraries, file/network effects or SDK dependencies. Runtime is a host behavior assertion, not VM isolation or a complete upstream project build.
